Tis the season, beauty lovers! Sephora’s 2026 Advent Calendars are rolling out, and the first set is live NOW! You can score the Sephora Collection 24-Day Advent Calendar for just $60 ($190 value).

Plus, Beauty Insiders (free to join) score free shipping!

Mark your calendars for the massive Sephora Favorites 25-Day Advent Calendar next, hitting the Sephora app on September 22nd and online September 23rd.

Sephora Collection Advent Calendar $60 – $190 value!
Shipping is free for Beauty Insiders
Final cost $60 shipped!

Unwrap $190 worth of beauty for only $60! This 24-day countdown is packed with 13 full-size products, 5 travel sizes, and 6 handy accessories across makeup, skincare, and bath.

It’s basically December’s ultimate daily beauty surprise drawer!

Sephora Favorites 25-Days of Beauty Advent Calendar $105 – $393 value!
Shipping is free for Beauty Insiders
Final cost $105 shipped!

*Available exclusively in the Sephora app 9/22 + on all other online platforms 9/23.

Now THIS is the big kahuna! 👀 For $105, the Sephora Favorites calendar is loaded with 25 full- and deluxe-size treats worth a massive $393! The lineup is insanely stacked with top-tier brands like Fenty Beauty, Summer Fridays, Armani, Benefit, Tarte, Kiehl’s, Moroccanoil, and more.

Grab these advent calendars before they’re gone…
